part_strategy.title: Part-by-Part Strategy
part_strategy.subtitle: Time allocation and proven techniques for each part.
items: Part 1: Use direction audio time to preview images, identifying core actions and spatial positions.
Part 2: Focus sharply on the opening question word (Who, Where, When, Why, How) and avoid same-sound traps.
Part 3 & 4: Always preview the 3 questions and answer choices before the audio conversation plays.
Part 5: Identify the required part of speech before translating full meaning to save valuable time.
Part 6: Read with whole-paragraph context, especially for full sentence insertion questions.
Part 7: Skim questions first, identify key keywords, and locate supporting evidence in the text.

common_mistakes.title: Common Mistakes
common_mistakes.subtitle: Frequent pitfalls and how to avoid them.
items: Homophone and similar-sounding word traps in Listening Part 1 & 2 (e.g., walk / work, coffee / copy).
Dwelling too long on single difficult questions, running out of time for easier ones later.
Misaligning answer sheet numbers after skipping a question.
Overlooking negative question words (NOT, EXCEPT, LEAST likely).
Failing to verify verb tense and subject-verb agreement in sentence completion.

time_management.title: Time Management
time_management.subtitle: Pacing strategies for speed and precision.
items: Listening (45 mins): Strictly follow the recording speed; guess promptly if a question is missed.
Part 5 (30 questions): Finish within 10 - 12 minutes (averaging 20 - 25 seconds per question).
Part 6 (16 questions): Finish within 6 - 8 minutes.
Part 7 (54 questions): Dedicate the full remaining 52 - 55 minutes. Tackle single passages before double/triple ones.
Always reserve the final 2 - 3 minutes to double check the entire answer sheet.

vocabulary_grammar.title: Key Vocabulary & Grammar
vocabulary_grammar.subtitle: Essential grammar topics and vocabulary banks.
items: Business and corporate vocabulary: contracts, marketing, travel, banking, real estate, personnel.
Relative clauses and reduced relative clauses (V-ing / V-ed).
Conditionals (types 1, 2, 3) and subjunctive mood (suggest/recommend + that + S + [should] + V bare).
Correlative conjunctions: neither...nor, either...or, not only...but also, both...and.
Prepositions of time and place (in, on, at, during, while, throughout).

high_score_tips.title: High Score Experiences
high_score_tips.subtitle: Proven insights from 800+ TOEIC achievers.
items: Build daily English listening habits through dictation exercises.
Always review full transcripts and error explanations after every mock test.
Maintain a vocabulary notebook containing words in authentic contexts and collocations.
Take uninterrupted full 120-minute mock tests under real conditions at least once a week before the exam.

guide.title: TOEIC Exam Instructions
guide.ets_rule_content: Total test duration is 120 minutes with 2 sections: Listening (45 mins, 100 questions) and Reading (75 mins, 100 questions).
guide.sec1_item1: Ensure your headphones and audio device function properly before starting Listening Part 1 - 4.
guide.sec1_item2: Prepare a quiet study environment and mute notifications to maintain full focus for 2 hours.
guide.sec2_item1: Click 'Start Test' on any test card to open the examination interface.
guide.sec2_item2: Use the question navigation drawer to flag questions you want to revisit.
guide.sec2_item3: Upon submitting, your exam is auto-graded with detailed part-by-part analysis.
